profile.headline: Embedded Engineering at Formlabs
profile.summary:
Hands-on engineering manager and technical lead, working on electrical engineering and embedded systems for products that help people bring their vision to life.

Currently shipping 3D printers at Formlabs, and software at KiCad EDA.

*** Please note that I do not accept LinkedIn connection requests from those I do not know personally.  Please feel free to send me an email if you would like to get in touch. ***

https://craftyjon.com

positions.title: Staff Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: Trying something new!  Building the software that runs Formlabs' hardware products.

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Lead
positions.description:
Led a team of engineers responsible for developing hardware and firmware from concept to mass production. Building the next generation of accessible and high-quality SLA and SLS 3D printers. 

Responsible for the growth and success of the team, as well as overall electronics architecture for Formlabs products and full-stack technical contributions to new product development projects.

Personally responsible for the electronics architecture and key engineering contributions on the Fuse X1 SLS printer.  Before that, contributed to the design of Form 4/4L, Fuse 1+, and other Formlabs hardware products.

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Lead - SLA Products
positions.description: Led a team of electrical engineers working on professional SLA 3D printers.  Responsible for electrical system architecture and overall technical success.  Designed the Form 3 / 3L electronics platform, and contributed to PCB design, embedded Linux bringup, and product integration.

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
One of the lead developers (project maintainers) of KiCad, the most popular and capable open-source EDA suite in the world.  I help set the direction for KiCad development, architect and develop new features (primarily in C++), squash bugs, and help to grow the community of developers, testers, and users.

Key contributions include:

- Architecting and developing a robust and full-function API for third-party plugin and tool integration, as well as developing and maintaining a Python library (kicad-python) as the reference API client implementation.
- Building an ODBC-based database library system allowing KiCad to plug in to library databases used by teams and businesses, then reworking the rest of KiCad's library system to improve performance and get rid of workflow-blocking loading screens.
- Reworking and redesigning key parts of the KiCad user interface and user experience, including the Appearance panel, Properties panel, selection filters, and modern color theme introduced with KiCad 6.
- Building a real-time schematic netlisting system that enabled features such as bus unfolding, performant net highlighting on large schematics, and live net coloring.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Product Management · Software Architecture · Project Management · Software Design

positions.title: Hardware Engineering Team Leader
positions.description: In addition to hardware engineering duties described below, led a team of three other engineers.  Monitored team progress on tasks and goals, managed work distribution to the team, and served as the point of contact for interdepartmental planning and development.

positions.title: Hardware Engineer
positions.description: Full-stack design of electronics for rugged portable XRF instruments including system architecture, design of embedded data acquisition and processing systems, signal processing in FPGAs, embedded Linux system design, and firmware/software development.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Provided support and advice to teams of students in developing musical hardware and software, and taught concepts of analog sensor filtering, op-amp circuit design, and programmatic data filtering.

positions.title: Recording Engineer and Technician
positions.description: Recorded and edited multi-track audio and multi-camera video of music performances.  Provided frontline support and administration for a multimedia computer lab.
